gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: Cannot create or test a second auction with sealed bids because no setup recipe or operation creates a second auction or configures sealed bidding.
Cannot check rank before the auction starts because no available setup or operation provides that pre-start auction state.
Cannot model the required vendor revisions because no revision operation or assertion field is available.
Traffic colour is not available in the read-back fields or assertion vocabulary.
The available indicator read-back exposes rank and best_bidder, but not the vendor card itself.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for only about two minutes.
steps: The buyer converts the pricing round into a live auction.
The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live pricing round for a second QA vendor.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
A second QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
The buyer reads the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder).
Wait until the round has closed (bid end and extra closing time over).
As the buyer, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that Schema check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank” is absent.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Schema check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank” is absent.
